messages:
Maya (PM): Quick follow-up from the demo: the help panel and docs use different phrasing for the pin workflow and the deep links don't land on the right section. Users got stuck.

Kevin (Design): Noted. In-panel CTA is 'Learn more' and jumps to top. Propose: CTA -> 'See pinning docs' and deep-link to exact anchor. Also switch panel headings to sentence case.

Sylvia (DevEx): Our getDocLink helper can accept an anchor; will add fragment support and an ID convention like inlay-doc-<route>.

Raj (Eng): I'll implement fragment param, target=_blank + rel, and support ariaLabel override in the helper. ETA tomorrow AM.

Emma (A11y): Ensure external links have aria-label ('Opens docs in new tab'), icon buttons are keyboard-focusable, and close button has aria-controls.

DocBot: Added linter rule 'console-doc-fragment' to warn on missing fragments. PR: https://git.internal/rdw/pulls/520

Maya (PM): Great. Action owners: Raj (link helper + tests), Sylvia (docs heading id + style note), Kevin (copy + spacing), Emma (a11y checklist). Reopen if more mismatches found. :white_check_mark:
